environment.description: Deployed in a Kubernetes pod with a distroless base image. The pod spec uses a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) with an emptyDir volume mounted exclusively at /var/app/plugins/ (no other writable mounts). The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the cluster DNS. The frontend is served through a CDN edge node (Cloudflare) with a Content-Security-Policy response header that includes script-src directives requiring SRI hashes: `script-src 'sha384-oqVuAfXRKap7fdgcCY5uykM6+R9GqQ8K/uxy9rx7HNQlGYl1kPzQho1wx4JwY8wC'`. The Cloudflare managed transform rule injects the CSP header on all HTML responses regardless of origin server headers. Additionally, the pod's securityContext sets allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and drops ALL capabilities. The emptyDir volume is size-limited to 10Mi with medium: Memory (tmpfs).

config.cdn: Cloudflare with managed transform rule injecting CSP on text/html responses
config.sri_enforcement: CSP script-src with hash-based allowlist enforced at CDN edge
